select TOP 50 ma_kho, ten_kho, ten_kho2, dia_chi, dien_thoai, dien_thoai2, fax, email, web, ma_qg, ma_kv, status, user_id0, user_id2, datetime0, datetime2, tdx, tdy, ma_ttp, ma_loai, unit_id, hc_yn, kkh_yn, hk_yn, chon_yn from dmkhobai where dbo.ufn_removeMark(ten_kho) like N'%' + @ten_kho + N'%' OR dbo.ufn_removeMark(ma_kho) like N'%' + @ma_kho + N'%' OR dbo.ufn_removeMark(ma_qg) like N'%' + @ma_qg + N'%';
